good_thing: (Bangor, Maine): On September 4, the Patriot Riders of America Maine Chapter 3 held its 10th annual Bike Show and Barbecue at the Maine Veterans’ Home. Riders brought sidecars and slingshots for accessible joyrides with residents, with live music and food alongside the rides.
current_or_history: On this day in 1977, Voyager 1 launched from Cape Canaveral carrying its Golden Record: a gold-plated copper time capsule with 115 images, sounds from Earth, music, and greetings in 55 languages. A very human message in a very large bottle.
tiny_fact: Sea otters have loose folds of skin beneath their forearms that work as pockets. While floating on their backs, they can stash food or a favorite rock there.
thought: You do not have to make the whole day meaningful; one good small thing will do.
